note: The acceptance gate's reading, committed as two ID SETS — never as counts. CI compares every push:[main] run against them and fails on any difference, and the PR path compares the collected ids against their union so a rename or deletion is caught where it is made. Counts were the earlier defect twice over: a regression offset by a gain leaves a count unchanged, and a met clause could be renamed or deleted with a one-digit edit while everything read green. The suite being red by design is not the same thing as the run being red — the run is green while the reading is exactly what this file says.
